scope: Only field projection and arithmetic/temporal consistency checks of frozen saved JSON; no sensing, planner invocation, TSDF, quality computation or new counterfactual execution.

time_axis.t_definition_zh: t 表示已经完成的付费动作数。obs 0 为尚未执行动作的初始观测；obs t 在第 t 个动作执行后产生。
time_axis.posterior_definition_zh: 图中 t 处后验是消费 obs t 后、选择第 t+1 个动作前的权重。
time_axis.divergence_definition_zh: obs 18 后产生动作选择分歧，执行为第 19 个动作；obs 28 的几何反馈纠正后验，下一动作在第 29 步执行。不能把这些事件统称第 18/28 步执行分歧。
time_axis.terminal_definition_zh: obs 42 是最后一个动作后的观测，后验存在但没有第 43 个动作。
time_axis.not_physical_time_zh: 横轴为动作索引；前进和转向各计一次，不能标作秒。
time_axis.posterior_scope_zh: h1 由离线报告标识真实构型用于解释图线，不作为控制器输入；曲线为未校准模型权重。
time_axis.pose_definition_zh: pose_x_y_heading 的第三维是整数朝向，不是高度。

display_guidance.plot_type: post-update step or connected markers; do not smooth or interpolate new observations
display_guidance.confirmation_scope: V36 supplies G/S only; X/Xnf belong to V35 development, never label them V36 confirmation.
display_guidance.feedback_intervention_scope: Xnf disables both actual feedback and future information prediction. The saved same-state posterior-only audit isolates the actual correction; it has no counterfactual terminal quality.

counterfactual_plan.forecast_scope: one nonperfect information event per receding lookahead; uncalibrated approximation
counterfactual_plan.objective_scope: public-template potential area times ideal center coverage, not measured Q

copied_saved_record.scope: same saved state and future information; substitute only posterior, no new physical outcome
